PostSummary: Videos show crystals for anxiety, tarot pulls for decisions, and cleansing rituals for bad energy, presented as harmless self-care with spiritual benefits. The practices promise control over an uncertain life.
BiblicalResponse: Anxiety and uncertainty are real, and the longing for peace is good — but peace does not come from objects or cards. Scripture points us to a God who invites us to cast our cares on Him because He cares for us personally. If a practice promises spiritual power apart from God, it is not neutral self-care; it is a substitute for the relationship you were made for.
